component.name: tio-gui
component.summary: Connect to serial devices and inspect their output

description.p: tio-gui is a serial workspace for embedded development. On Linux, it manages tio sessions in an embedded terminal, with device discovery, connection profiles, automatic reconnection and session logging.

Open several devices in separate tabs, send text or binary commands, record and replay data, and inspect captured output with filters and plots. Serial access requires permission to open the selected device.
Fixes session restoration and settings persistence, improves portable macOS character conversion, and adds self-contained Linux packages.
Improves macOS system appearance handling and package version checks.
